reason: Directive 09's schema made `geometry` mandatory even for position-unknown (stub) entities, forcing invented anchor coordinates into the Spatial Index. Directive 09.1 §1.1: 'do not invent a coordinate — if there is no basis for a position, do not draw it.' This file preserves what was removed, not to restore it, but as a record of the mistake so it is not repeated.
